exposure: outpatient induction of labor by Foley catheter
in-patient induction of labor by Foley catheter
cohort: 485 women scheduled for induction of labor by Foley catheter at Helsinki University Hospital between January 2011 and January 2012
finding: Outpatient induction of labor by Foley catheter was not associated with differences in cesarean delivery or infection rates compared with in-patients, and most women were satisfied with outpatient induction.
